brief: A vast, liminal indoor space is occupied by a massive, shallow pool of water. The surface of the water is constantly rippling, creating a fluid, ever-changing plane. The core visual experience is the dynamic interplay between light and shadow. As the water ripples, the reflections and the movement of the surface cause deep, intricate shadows to shift, play, and grow across the floor beneath the pool, transforming the seemingly still environment into a place of constant, silent flux.
